input: Find nature, outdoor adventure, farm, horseback riding and fishing summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Arden, Fletcher, Skyland, Fairview and Mills River, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Arden Fletcher Mills River summer camp horseback riding farm 2026
Asheville south Hendersonville outdoor adventure summer camp 2026 fishing

candidates.name: NovusWay Ministries
candidates.note: Lutheridge offers children's and teens' summer camps with hiking, swimming, outdoor adventure and Christian activities.

candidates.name: Mountain Roots
candidates.note: 2027 camps include Fletcher sessions at FernLeaf, nature-based day camps and Pisgah Forest backpacking programs.

candidates.name: Town of Fletcher Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 summer day camp included nature activities, field trips, swimming, sports and crafts.

candidates.name: Project HNG
candidates.note: Formerly Hickory Nut Gap Farm Camp; farm day camp combines horseback riding, wilderness skills, farm activities and art.

candidates.name: Camp Grier
candidates.note: WORX summer program serves public-school middle graders with trades, paddleboarding, outdoor cooking and fly fishing.

candidates.name: Town of Mills River Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: Summer Science Camp for grades 1–5 explores native plants, animals and insects; also offers summer tennis camps.

candidates.name: Camp Highlander
candidates.note: Residential summer camp for boys and girls ages 6–16 with outdoor adventure and traditional camp activities.

candidates.name: The North Carolina Arboretum
candidates.note: Discovery Camp offers week-long, mostly outdoor exploration on its 434-acre campus; 2027 dates forthcoming.

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.town: Arden, Fairview, Asheville, Candler and Hendersonville
candidates.note: 2026 Discovery camps included Arden and Fairview sites; Adventure Camp ages 9–15 offered hiking, riding, tubing and rafting.

candidates.name: Camp Cedar Cliff
candidates.note: Christian day and overnight camps include riding, climbing, rafting, ropes courses and wilderness skills.

candidates.name: Adventure Center of Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 summer day programs included Adventure Camps and Kolo Bike Park mountain-biking camps.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 summer programs included nature exploration and field trips, including an inclusive camp at Oakley Recreation Center.

candidates.name: The Educational Garden Project
candidates.note: 2026 Garden Camp ages 6–10 and CIT program ages 11–16 included gardening, animal care, cooking and nature exploration.

candidates.name: Local Cloth
candidates.note: 2026 Farm to Fabric day camps for ages 8–13 combined fiber-animal encounters with felting, spinning, dyeing and weaving.

candidates.name: Asheville Farmstead School
candidates.note: 2026 farm-and-forest camps for potty-trained children through age 12 covered gardening, farm skills, water and wildlife.

candidates.name: Ruby Ranch
candidates.note: 2026 summer camps combined horseback riding, arts, creek exploration and ranch activities.

candidates.name: Camp Tekoa
candidates.note: 2027 day, overnight and adventure camps serve elementary through high-school campers, with off-site outdoor excursions.

candidates.name: Camp Kanuga
candidates.note: 2027 overnight camps and teen programs include outdoor adventures; Trailblazers offers climbing, rafting and ziplining.

candidates.name: Camp Glen Arden
candidates.note: 2027 girls' overnight sessions serve grades 1–11, with hiking, biking, climbing and paddling adventures.
